note: Questions, information and answers needed before any decision can reasonably be made, based on what we already have and what we do not have. Each row: what is established, what is missing, the action that closes it, what it blocks, and the default if it stays unanswered. Suggestions that discover the missing information are cross-referenced.

questions.question: Is the shop one category or two — air fryers only, or air fryers plus meat thermometers?
questions.established: Three submitted links resolve to Air Fryers (17659096011); two resolve to Meat thermometers (289810). All five destinations are live official listings (2026-11-20).
questions.missing: The owner's scope decision. Nothing in the repository states which categories the site should cover.
questions.action: Pick a path in the chooser on /suggestions/ (Path A, B, or C).
questions.blocks: Information architecture, category pages, editorial calendar, internal-link clusters
questions.default: Path B (both categories) — the build covers everything verified; fully reversible

questions.question: What is the intended ASIN for each of the five submitted links?
questions.established: All five tokens are 9 characters; Amazon's ASIN definition is 10 characters. Each token's observed redirect destination is recorded in a separate field.
questions.missing: intended_asin, intended_listing_url, confirmation_date, intent_source — blank on all five rows; nothing public binds a short code to a product.
questions.action: Owner confirms each intended ASIN (or states that the observed destination is the intended one) in data/intent-record.
questions.blocks: Closing FLG-006, cross-checking redirects against intent
questions.default: Fields stay blank and flagged; observed values are published as observations only

questions.question: Is tracking ID shopnow047c-20 active, attached to this site, and showing clicks in Associates Reports?
questions.established: The ID was supplied by the owner and is appended to every outbound product link. Amazon requires a partnerTag on API lookups (example format xyz-20).
questions.missing: Associates dashboard confirmation (account access required). No click or order data exists yet.
questions.action: Sign in to Associates → Account → Tracking IDs; confirm status; click one tagged link and check the report.
questions.blocks: FLG-005, campaign ledger rows (SG-08), any revenue statement
questions.default: Links ship with the tag, marked unconfirmed; ledger stays empty

questions.question: Do the supplied link.amazon/* short links qualify as Special Links under Operating Agreement §1?
questions.established: §1 requires links to 'properly use the special tagged link formats we provide'. Each supplied token redirects to a live official listing (observed 2026-11-20). The brief says their exact compliance status is unresolved (FLG-003) and forbids claiming they are invalid.
questions.missing: Whether the format and domain are Amazon-provided Special Link formats; whether tracking is attributed in reports.
questions.action: One-link-per-product test in the enrolled Associates workflow: generate the official Special Link for each ASIN, confirm destination and tracking report, compare with the supplied short link (S02 of the brief).
questions.blocks: Scaling any outbound link style (SG-07); full FLG-003 closure
questions.default: Site links use official /dp/ listing URLs + tag + rel="sponsored"; supplied tokens are preserved in the register only

questions.question: What commission rate applies to each category?
questions.established: Commission is a percentage of Qualifying Revenue (Program Policies). The official schedule page exists but redirects to sign-in.
questions.missing: The rate table itself — not publicly readable without an Associates account (FLG-004).
questions.action: While signed in, read the Commission Income Statement appendix for the US rate for Kitchen/Small Appliances and for the thermometer category.
questions.blocks: Any commission-potential number, prioritization by expected yield
questions.default: Blank + unverified everywhere; no estimate is ever published

questions.question: Who is the published author behind the guides (byline identity)?
questions.established: Guides need authorship to read as a publication; the brief asks for authorship polish.
questions.missing: Owner's chosen byline (person or brand) and bio.
questions.action: Owner supplies byline name + one-paragraph bio; add /about/ page.
questions.blocks: About page, E-E-A-T signals, disclosure phrasing around the byline
questions.default: Byline reads 'WinA Editorial'; no fake persona is invented

questions.question: What is the canonical domain — the github.io project URL or a custom domain?
questions.established: GitHub Pages serves the repository root (S17); the project URL is https://sassnarep3-star.github.io/WinA/.
questions.action: Owner decides; if custom, add CNAME + update canonical/OG tags in the build.
questions.blocks: Search Console verification (Q-09), canonical tags, OG/Twitter cards, feed links
questions.default: Canonical = github.io project URL, used consistently

questions.question: Where will the self-hosted analytics endpoint run?
questions.established: GitHub Pages is static-only (S17); endpoint code ships in tools/analytics_endpoint.py; the counter queues events in the browser until an endpoint URL is set.
questions.missing: Hosting target (small VPS, container, serverless function on the owner's infra) and the HTTPS URL.
questions.action: Owner deploys the endpoint, sets ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT in assets/analytics.js, confirms /healthz.
questions.blocks: Real click data entering the campaign ledger (SG-03, SG-08)
questions.default: Events queue locally (localStorage, cap 100) and are never sent to a third party

questions.question: Who adds and verifies the Search Console property, and when?
questions.established: sitemap.xml and robots.txt ship with the site; Search Console needs owner verification (FLG-008).
questions.missing: Verification token/DNS record and the person responsible.
questions.action: Owner adds the property for the final domain, verifies, submits sitemap.xml, reviews the first query report.
questions.blocks: Choosing the next guide from measured queries (SG-18)
questions.default: Topic choice stays editorial-hypothesis-driven and labelled as such

questions.question: What publishing cadence does the owner commit to?
questions.established: The brief asks for a cadence; five guides ship now.
questions.action: Owner picks a number; add to the editorial calendar.
questions.default: 1 guide per week suggested, not assumed

questions.question: Will product imagery come from official Program Content (link builder / PA API)?
questions.established: Program Content includes data, images, text and link formats Amazon provides (S12). The build ships text-forward with no hotlinked images.
questions.action: Owner exports images through Associates link builder (or PA API after approval); wire into build.

questions.question: Is there a canonical list of 'the five defined events' from the original brief?
questions.established: No event list exists in the repository; this build defines page_view, outbound_click, affiliate_click, search_query, article_read (FLG-009).
questions.missing: The owner's canonical names, if any.
questions.action: Owner supplies the list or confirms this set; update assets/analytics.js and the platform page together.
questions.blocks: Closing FLG-009; event naming in the endpoint schema

questions.question: How stale may a price be before republication requires re-verification?
questions.established: All published prices are 2026-11-20 buy-box readings (FLG-007).
questions.action: Adopt a policy (recommended: re-fetch on the day of publication; never reuse a price older than 24 h).
questions.blocks: Automated price refresh in the build

questions.question: Which email/reader-capture provider will be used, and what does the privacy policy say?
questions.established: No form ships in this build; disclosure and endorsement rules apply to any future capture (S16).
questions.missing: Provider choice, data-retention terms, privacy-policy text.
questions.action: Owner picks a provider, reviews its terms, publishes a privacy policy line before any input field ships.
questions.default: No capture — nothing ships without this answered

questions.question: Is the Associates account in good standing with this site's URL listed as an approved site?
questions.established: Monetization requires a valid enrolled account; nothing in the repository proves enrollment status.
questions.missing: Account status + site URL approval (account access required).
questions.action: Owner checks Associates account settings; add the live URL to the site list if required.
questions.blocks: Any commission at all; Special Link test (Q-04)
questions.default: No earnings claims anywhere on the site; ledger stays empty
